detected_fault: thermal throttling and BSOD (Blue Screen of Death)
suggested_solution: Monitor system temperatures during intense usage to prevent thermal throttling.
Update drivers for the Radeon Graphics card to the latest version.
Ensure proper cooling system maintenance (e.g., clean dust from fans and heat sinks).
Consider upgrading to a more powerful graphics card, such as an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or higher.
